name: schedule-task
description: Scheduled, resumable automation tasks (dev/test/audit) driven by a single Node CLI — dispatcher, resilient runner, status, cancel, archive, batch merge. Git is the only transport; no runtime npm dependencies. Three-layer separation: install.sh installs the global CLI (tool); `schedule-task install` binds the knowledge skill into each agent (zero code); per-project .schedule-tasks-data (data).
